agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular San Dieguito Water District - 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 17, 2025 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. All Oral Communications speaker slips (“WHITE” speaker slip) must be received by the Clerk by the start of oral communications. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 29, 2025, Special Closed Session Meeting; and November 19, 2025, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Approval of the calendar year 2026 San Dieguito Water District Board meeting schedule. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Aguilar
Adopt Resolution 2025-14, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving the 2026 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule."
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08D 2026 Board Meeting Schedule
8E.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2025-26 1st Quarter Budget Report. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Aguilar
1) Receive and file the 1st Quarter Budget Report for Fiscal Year 2025-26; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-13, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget."
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08E FY 25-26 1st Qtr Budget Report
8F.
Award a Construction Contract for the Air Release and Blow Off Replacement Phase II (CW25D). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (b) of CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Scherch
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute a contract with HPS Mechanical, Inc. (HPS) in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extension in consultation with the Agency Attorney, in the amount of $881,060 plus an approximate 15 percent construction contingency of $132,159, $1,640 for bid notice, and $40,000 for on-call inspection and material testing for a total project not-to-exceed amount of $1,054,859 including any future contract amendments for the construction of the Air Release and Blow Off Replacement Phase II (CW25D); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-15, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget" to amend the FY 2025-26 budget by transferring 1,040,562 from Project No. CW23D Transmission Line Maintenance and $40,000 from Project No. CW25E On-Call Consultants, to fund Project No. CW25D, Air Release and Blow Off Replacement Phase II.
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08F Air Release and Blow Off Replacement Phase II (CW25D)
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08F Air Release and Blow Off Replacement Phase II (CW25D) Updated Att 3 pages 8-14
8G.
Authorization to award and approval of the sole source for an Agreement for Design Professional Consultant Services with Dudek for Cardiff Waterline Replacement Project (CW26E). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Scherch
1) Authorize the General Manager in consultation with the Agency Attorney, to execute an agreement for design professional consultant services, in substantial form, with Dudek, and any necessary amendments and time extensions in consultation with the Agency Attorney, in the amount of $147,230 plus a 15 percent contingency of $22,085 for a total not-to-exceed amount of $169,315; 2) Approve the sole source for design professional consultant services with Dudek for Cardiff Waterline Replacement project (CW26E); and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-16, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget" to amend the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget by transferring $295,420 from Water Infrastructure Improvements (CW23C) to fund Cardiff Waterline Replacement Design and Engineering Services During Construction (CW26E).
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S08G Cardiff Waterline Replacement Agreement
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Public Hearing to Consider Adoption of Resolution No. 2025-12, Implementing Adjustments to the San Dieguito Water District's Water Capacity Charges. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Alex
1) Receive public comments regarding the District's Water Capacity Charges; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-12, titled, a "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Increasing Water Capacity Charges on March 1, 2026, July 1, 2027, and July 1, 2028."
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S10A Capacity Charge Update
10B.
Award a Design-Build Agreement for the Advanced Metering Infrastructure Program. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) per Section 15302 (c) which exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. The Project involves replacement of water meters and no expansion of service or new structures. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Alex
1) Authorize the General Manager to execute an agreement with Ferguson Enterprises, LLC in substantial form, and necessary amendments and time extension in consultation with the Agency Attorney, in the amount of $850,953 for Phase 1 services plus an approximate 15 percent contingency of $127,500, for a total Phase 1 cost not-to-exceed amount of $978,453 for the Advanced Metering Infrastructure Program (CW26C); 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-09, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget" to Amend the FY 2025-26 budget by transferring $978,453 from Project No. CW23E Meter Replacement & Automation, to fund Project No. CW26C, Advanced Metering Infrastructure Program ("Project"); and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2025-17, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Authorizing the Sole Sourcing of Potable Water Meters from Neptune Technology Group."
2025-12-17 SDWD Item S10B Award AMI Design Build - Updated 12-15-2025 Page 42
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 28, 2025
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
